entities.name: Akbar the Great
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Third Mughal Emperor (1556–1605), widely considered the greatest Mughal ruler. Akbar expanded the empire across most of the Indian subcontinent, implemented progressive administrative reforms, and promoted religious tolerance through interfaith dialogue.
